title: Echo and Vector
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Xanthe Iversen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
